verdicts.originalText: After a plunge during Fiery Passion (or any plunge at C2), type sQ within the 2.33s Apex Drive window to cast Volcano Kablam — the 30-energy plunge-tagged secondary Burst with a 1s cooldown. Kablam shares Guardian Vent!'s cooldown slot: it waits for the burst cooldown and then puts it on a short 1s cooldown. Plain Q always casts the full Guardian Vent!.
verdicts.proposedText: Type sQ within the 2.33s Apex Drive window — opened by a plunge during Fiery Passion, or any plunge at C2 — to cast Volcano Kablam, the 30-energy plunge secondary burst.
verdicts.rationale: The live caveat is ~467 chars across ~4 sentences, breaching the 400-char hard cap and 2-sentence rule. Its load-bearing content is genuine user instruction: Volcano Kablam is not auto-selected, so the player must know to type the sQ token and when the Apex Drive window is open — this is the {coldDish:5}-style notation-token exception, not working behavior, so it stays a rewrite rather than a delete. Compression: strip 'Guardian Vent!' (this ability, already shown in the panel), keep the sQ instruction plus its two gating conditions (plunge in Fiery Passion / any plunge at C2) and the window duration, and identify the target (Volcano Kablam, 30-energy plunge secondary burst). Dropped the 1s cooldown, the shared-cooldown-slot mechanics, and 'plain Q casts the full burst' because those are all wired/modeled (curator notes: variant keeps the default shared-clock behavior with cooldown 1; plain Q resolves to the base variant) and describing correctly-modeled behavior is not a caveat's job. Result ~169 chars, one sentence; sQ is safe under the camelCase lint pattern.
